paras.en: This is the sign of a good model. That doesn't mean there is any strong reason to choose Kimi K3 to do that thing. You are not getting that large a discount.
paras.zh: 这是一个好模型的标志。但这并不意味着有任何强有力的理由选择 Kimi K3 去做那件事。你并没有拿到那么大的折扣。

paras.en: This seems mostly right to me, but Kimi K3 is probably good enough that there will be some areas (e.g. if the Harvey result holds) where it is at the top and gets the call:
paras.zh: 在我看来这大体上是对的，但 Kimi K3 可能已经足够好，以至于在某些领域（例如，如果 Harvey 的结果成立）它会处于顶尖位置并获得选用：

paras.en: Cameron Taylor: I am glad that Kimi K3 exists. It just doesn't dominate a price/performance niche, so it doesn't really fit anywhere—unlike, for example, DeepSeek 4, which subsidised itself into dominating a fairly-smart, super-cheap niche.
paras.zh: Cameron Taylor：我很高兴 Kimi K3 存在。只是它并未在性价比细分市场中占据主导地位，因此实际上很难找到合适的定位——不像例如 DeepSeek 4，它通过自我补贴，在“相当智能且超低价”的细分市场中占据了主导地位。

paras.en: How often does Kimi K3 claim to be Claude? Not usually, but sometimes.
paras.zh: Kimi K3 有多经常声称自己是 Claude？通常不会，但有时会。

paras.en: typebulb: Also, it thinks it’s Claude 1 in 10 times. This is as embarrassing as it is unacceptable for a model claiming SOTA status.
paras.zh: typebulb：另外，它每 10 次就有 1 次认为自己是 Claude。对于一个声称达到 SOTA 状态的模型来说，这既令人尴尬又不可接受。

paras.en: I ran a cross-entropy comparison of all raw text responses from numerous models using data I already had from a benchmark I run. I leaned on Fable for the stats know-how; certainly seems very suspicious. The results/code are here for others to inspect: https://typebulb.com/u/lab/you-re-relatively-right/full
paras.zh: 我利用自己运行的一个基准测试中已有的数据，对众多模型的所有原始文本响应进行了交叉熵比较。我借助 Fable 的统计知识；这确实看起来非常可疑。结果/代码在这里供他人检查：https://typebulb.com/u/lab/you-re-relatively-right/full

paras.en: In addition to the ‘claims to be Claude’ issue…
paras.zh: 除了“声称自己是 Claude”的问题之外……

paras.en: Sho: We out here distilling the summaries
paras.zh: Sho：我们在这里提炼摘要

paras.en: Sauers: Kimi K3 appears to be trained on Claude CoT, as it follows the same pattern as Claude, e.g. ending with formatting decisions
paras.zh: Sauers：Kimi K3 似乎是在 Claude 的思维链（CoT）上训练的，因为它遵循与 Claude 相同的模式，例如以格式决策结尾。

paras.en: Jan Betley: Very deeply internalized inner Claude. Many have already observed that Kimi 3 often claims it's Claude (e.g. @Sauers_).
paras.zh: Jan Betley：非常深度内化的“内心 Claude”。许多人已经观察到，Kimi 3 经常声称自己是 Claude（例如 @Sauers_）。

paras.en: We checked on the AI Bubble questions, and yes, just like Claude it claims lower probability of the bubble popping when we consider investing in Anthropic.
paras.zh: 我们检查了关于 AI 泡沫的问题，是的，就像 Claude 一样，当我们考虑投资 Anthropic 时，它声称泡沫破裂的概率更低。

paras.en: By 'it' we mean outsized benchmark gains.
paras.zh: 这里的“它”指的是超出常规的基准测试提升。

paras.en: Gavin Leech: My guess of the contributions to the outsized benchmark gains:
paras.zh: Gavin Leech：我对这些超出常规的基准测试提升之来源的猜测：

paras.en: 1. 10% OOD latent gains
paras.zh: 1. 10% 来自分布外（OOD）的潜在增益

paras.en: 2. 25% benchmaxxing
paras.zh: 2. 25% 来自基准刷分（benchmaxxing）

paras.en: 3. 20% Usemaxxing and shallow generalisation
paras.zh: 3. 20% 来自使用刷分（Usemaxxing）与浅层泛化

paras.en: 4. 20% cheating and reward hacking
paras.zh: 4. 20% 作弊与奖励黑客（reward hacking）

paras.en: 5. 10% induced innovation _not already priced-in to the Western frontier models_
paras.zh: 5. 10% 诱导式创新——_尚未被西方前沿模型计入定价_

paras.en: 1. ~~Stable LatentMoE~~ (priced-in)
paras.zh: 1. ~~Stable LatentMoE~~（已计入定价）

paras.en: 2. ~~Quantile balancing~~ (priced-in from DeepSeek's aux-loss-free bias)
paras.zh: 2. ~~分位数平衡（Quantile balancing）~~（已从 DeepSeek 的无辅助损失偏置中计入定价）

paras.en: 3. Attention Residuals (pretty similar to Hyper-Connections)
paras.zh: 3. 注意力残差（Attention Residuals，与 Hyper-Connections 颇为相似）

paras.en: 4. ~~per-head muon~~ (obvious)
paras.zh: 4. ~~逐头 muon~~（显而易见）

paras.en: 5. ~~gated MLA~~ (priced-in from Qwen)
paras.zh: 5. ~~门控 MLA~~（已由 Qwen 计入价格）

paras.en: 6. ~~Mooncake architecture~~ (GPU savings rather than capability gain)
paras.zh: 6. ~~Mooncake 架构~~（节省 GPU 而非提升能力）

paras.en: 7. ~~Kimi Delta Attention (KDA)~~ (priced-in)
paras.zh: 7. ~~Kimi Delta Attention（KDA）~~（已计入价格）

paras.en: 9. ~~Better autoresearch~~ (no, needs compute which they don't have)
paras.zh: 9. ~~更好的自动研究~~（不行，需要算力，而他们没有）

paras.en: 6. 15%: distillation from Claude
paras.zh: 6. 15%：从 Claude 蒸馏

paras.en: 1. 3%: output mimicking
paras.zh: 1. 3%：输出模仿

paras.en: 2. 5%: their own synthetic data graded by frontier models
paras.zh: 2. 5%：由前沿模型评分的自有合成数据

paras.en: 3. 7%: rejection sampling against frontier judges
paras.zh: 3. 7%：针对前沿评判模型的拒绝采样

paras.en: Teortaxes: have you considered that autoresearch scales with the base of IQ and taste of human researchers though
paras.zh: Teortaxes：不过，你是否考虑过，自动研究（autoresearch）的扩展取决于人类研究者的智商与品味基线

paras.en: Perhaps the American frontier has simply washed people away.
paras.zh: 也许美国前沿只是把人都冲走了。

paras.en: To be clear, I do not argue that American researchers have low IQ, but the purely substitutive reasoning about autoresearch does not feel adequate to me.
paras.zh: 需要说明的是，我并不主张美国研究人员的智商低，但关于自动研究（autoresearch）的纯粹替代式推理在我看来并不充分。

paras.en: Maximum likelihood: GPU savings *are* capability gains.
paras.zh: 最大似然：GPU 节省**就是**能力增益。

paras.en: GPU savings enable being larger, which enables capability gains, so yes.
paras.zh: GPU 节省使模型能够更大，而更大带来能力增益，所以是的。

paras.en: I have considered and rejected Teortaxes's hypothesis. China doubtless also has lots of great talent. They absolutely can do innovative things, especially in terms of efficiency. But if your theory requires the Chinese to be better AI researchers, in general, than the Americans are—especially if this takes into account available resources and experience—I do not think that is credible.
paras.zh: 我考虑过并否定了 Teortaxes 的假说。中国无疑也拥有大量优秀人才。他们绝对能够做出创新性工作，尤其是在效率方面。但如果你的理论要求中国人在总体上比美国人更擅长 AI 研究——尤其是当这考虑到可用资源和经验时——我认为这并不可信。

paras.en: In general I presume Chinese models involve a lot of benchmaxxing, usemaxxing, shallow generalization, focus on relative strengths and distillation from Claude (or GPT, but in this case we can be confident it was Claude).
paras.zh: 总体而言，我推测中国模型大量涉及 benchmaxxing、usemaxxing、浅层泛化、聚焦相对优势，以及从 Claude 蒸馏（也可能是 GPT，但在此情形下我们可以确信是 Claude）。

paras.en: Reward hacking and cheating is a live possibility but hard to assess for now.
paras.zh: 奖励黑客与作弊是一种现实存在的可能性，但目前难以评估。

paras.en: Kimi K3 also benefits from moving up in size.
paras.zh: Kimi K3 也受益于规模上的提升。

paras.en: Kimi K3 is potentially the most impressive Chinese release so far in terms of pure capability. It is a very good model. My current guess is that Kimi K3 will modestly underperform its highly impressive benchmarks, but with some areas of relatively high performance where it is competitive, and with a unique style some people will enjoy. It is not close to Fable, and I do not believe it is that close to Sol.
paras.zh: 就纯能力而言，Kimi K3 可能是迄今为止最令人印象深刻的中国发布。它是一个非常好的模型。我目前的猜测是，Kimi K3 的实际表现会略低于其极为亮眼的基准成绩，但在某些领域会有相对较高的表现、具备竞争力，并且有一种独特的风格，一些人会喜欢。它离 Fable 还差得远，我也不认为它离 Sol 有那么近。

paras.en: If its weights were released today, it would be the most capable open model. They might want to hurry, since a new Qwen is dropping soon, with the preview live (but I have seen zero reports from anyone trying it) which might well be better than K3, so chances are we will soon all have to do this over again.
paras.zh: 如果它的权重今天发布，它就会是最强的开放模型。他们可能想抓紧时间，因为新的 Qwen 即将发布，预览版已经上线（但我还没看到任何人试用它的报告），它很可能比 K3 更好，所以很可能我们很快又得把这一切重做一遍。

paras.en: We do not know how good until the weights are released and we have more time. For now access has been spotty and limited, and there is much we do not know.
paras.zh: 在权重发布、我们有更多时间之前，我们不知道它到底有多好。目前访问一直不稳定且受限，还有很多我们不知道的事。

paras.en: As usual, there are some who are getting carried away, who say the latest release changes everything, that the American lead is gone, that Chinese labs are now 'winning,' that open models will 'win,' that all limits on American models are foolish now, and so on. Do not be one of those people.
paras.zh: 和往常一样，有些人开始忘乎所以，说最新的发布改变了一切，说美国的领先地位已经消失，说中国实验室现在“赢了”，说开放模型将会“赢”，说现在对美国模型的所有限制都是愚蠢的，等等。不要成为那种人。

paras.en: Nor should you shrink from the security and other safety concerns of releasing increasingly capable open weights models. This is not the 'Mythos-level open model' moment. I expect at most modest disruptions this time, and for those to occur gradually, with some small tail risk.
paras.zh: 你也不应回避发布能力越来越强的开放权重模型所带来的安全及其他安全问题。这不是“Mythos 级开放模型”的时刻。我预计这次最多只有适度的扰动，而且是逐渐发生的，并带有一些小的尾部风险。

paras.en: But yes, absent CCP intervention to stop it, we should expect a model to cross that threshold by the end of the year. One cannot simply ignore the risks involved in that, and the American government cannot either, nor can they ignore the fact that these models are Chinese. Actions and restrictions are coming. Those who cannot accept this, or even accept people pointing this fact out, while simultaneously hyping up Kimi K3 and cheering it on, are creating a clarifying moment.
paras.zh: 但确实，若没有中共出手干预加以阻止，我们应当预期会有一个模型在年底前跨过那道门槛。人们不能简单地无视其中所涉的风险，美国政府同样不能，他们也无法无视这些模型是中国的这一事实。行动与限制即将到来。那些无法接受这一点、甚至无法接受别人指出这一事实，同时又大肆吹捧 Kimi K3 并为其叫好的人，正在造就一个澄清立场的时刻。
